purpose: Leakage-safe pre-race L1 evaluation payload for downstream L2 research and inference.

contribution_semantics.family_contribution_logit: Signed sum of per-feature TreeSHAP contributions within each canonical Feature Set family.
contribution_semantics.family_abs_contribution: Sum of absolute per-feature TreeSHAP contributions within each family.
contribution_semantics.family_abs_share: family_abs_contribution divided by total absolute contribution across all families for the horse.
contribution_semantics.raw_margin_logit: bias_logit plus all signed family contributions; should reconstruct the model raw margin.

race_summary.field_size: Number of starters represented by this model for the race.
race_summary.top2_probability: Second-highest race-normalized win probability or null.
race_summary.top1_top2_gap: top1_probability minus top2_probability, or null when fewer than two starters.
race_summary.top3_probability_mass: Sum of the three highest race-normalized win probabilities.
race_summary.normalized_entropy: Shannon entropy divided by log(field_size); 0 means maximally concentrated, 1 means maximally diffuse.

l2_join_policy.outcomes: Join only inside L2 training/evaluation after the L1 payload has been materialized.
l2_join_policy.market: Join only through the L2 market pipeline using a prediction-time/timestamp policy. Never feed market values back into L1.
l2_join_policy.2026_lock: 2026 remains sealed until L1/L2 model and selection rules are frozen for final confirmation.
